episodic.match_function_sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_{{knowledge_table_name}}(
  query_embedding vector({{vector_dimensions}}),
  org_id uuid,
  match_threshold float DEFAULT 0.72,
  match_count int DEFAULT 5
) RETURNS TABLE (id uuid, content text, similarity float, metadata jsonb)
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    k.id,
    k.content,
    1 - (k.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity,
    k.metadata
  FROM {{knowledge_table_name}} k
  WHERE k.organization_id = org_id
    AND 1 - (k.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY k.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
